verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Salesforce publishing its own official MCP server (salesforcecli/mcp) so external tools can call Salesforce — the opposite direction from the story, which asks whether Sales Cloud/Agentforce can consume external MCP servers as tools. No documentation shows Agentforce or Sales Cloud importing/plugging in third-party MCP servers to extend its own tool use. missing for 10: evidence of Agentforce/Sales Cloud acting as an MCP client, configuration steps for adding external MCP servers, and any hands-on confirmation of this working.
